cases.name: S3 RSA-3072 DS signing
prerequisites: approved D12 key custody and provisioning plan
exact S3 identity and source-matched image
cases.expected: S3 completes a fresh RSA-3072 DS signature challenge without exporting private key material.
blocked_when: DS key is not provisioned under a separately approved procedure
identity or image provenance is unknown

cases.name: TLS 1.2 mTLS using hardware signer
cases.expected: TLS 1.2 handshake authenticates the permanent Hub certificate using the S3 DS signer.
blocked_when: server or client trust is not established

cases.name: Client and server certificate validation
prerequisites: approved test CA and trusted-time evidence
cases.expected: Valid client/server chains pass; wrong CA, server name, purpose, validity interval, and unsupported TLS/signature profiles fail closed.
blocked_when: trusted time or approved test trust bundle is unavailable
target TLS/signature profile is not approved

cases.name: Unknown, revoked, expired, and invalid credentials
prerequisites: isolated negative-test identities and revocation fixture
cases.expected: Unknown, revoked, expired, malformed, wrong-purpose, and wrong-key credentials are rejected without durable completion.
blocked_when: test credentials can reach production services

cases.name: Wrong Hub, Home, and installation epoch
prerequisites: isolated ownership registry with controlled Home/epoch fixtures
cases.expected: Wrong Hub, Home, or stale epoch is rejected; no event is reparented or committed under another Home.
blocked_when: authoritative ownership fixture is not controlled or auditable

cases.name: Network outage and reconnect
cases.expected: CloudSync pauses safely during outage, retains the exact pending event, and retries after secure reconnect.
blocked_when: outage stimulus may affect unrelated devices or production endpoints

cases.name: Hub restart and exact EventKey retry
prerequisites: approved restart method and pending-event ledger
cases.expected: After an authorized restart, the original EventKey/body is retried byte-identically and not reparented.
blocked_when: restart procedure or event identity cannot be independently observed

cases.name: Duplicate suppression and durable backend completion
cases.expected: Repeated exact EventKey has one durable effect; only an exact durable receipt permits outbox completion.
blocked_when: receipt is not transaction-bound to the exact Home/Hub/epoch/EventKey

cases.name: Heap, TLS timing, and runtime stability
cases.expected: Repeated TLS and CloudSync cycles remain within approved heap, timing, reset, and pending-work limits.
blocked_when: numeric acceptance bounds or measurement methods remain unapproved

cases.name: Signed firmware compatibility and rollback
prerequisites: approved rollback and persistent-data recovery plan
cases.expected: Authorized signed image update and failed-health rollback preserve identity, pending events, and durable completion state.
blocked_when: signed images, rollback matrix, or destructive-operation authorization are absent
